interpretation: One creative run per initial task; assisted public revisions are recorded separately. This collection is not a comparative benchmark. Original captures and unmodified originals are retained privately. Raw SDK traces and machine-specific configuration are not part of this public repository.

pagoda.notes: The initial pagoda task was resumed twice after operational interruptions, within its original two-hour deadline. The output-token cap was increased from 32768 to 131072 during that run. The other tasks started with 131072.

pinball.notes: The user prioritized quality over a two-hour overall limit. Four independent reviews were sent through native Harness steering, including positive verification feedback. The original segment self-finished within its technical limit. The caller did not edit the game implementation.

public_revision.kind: Assisted refinement from preserved originals; caller supplied concrete fixes and independently verified the results.
public_revision.additional_user_request: Mouse/arrow formula reference picking, followed by a user-reported stale highlight after committing an in-cell formula

caller_contributions: Initial task descriptions and five native steering reviews for the public revision
Independent browser verification and visual inspection
Gallery, README, verification records, screenshots and publication packaging
Aquarium package name/build-script metadata cleanup; dependency versions and all app HTML bytes are retained

independent_verification.pinball_launch_sweep: 4 charge levels, 30 seconds each; normal controls and read-only position observations
independent_verification.artifact_adoption: Final frozen bytes match preserved copies used for independent verification; no app implementation edits by the caller
independent_verification.mobile_scope: Emulated touch viewport, primarily 390x844; not a physical-device compatibility survey
independent_verification.source_rebuilds: Both 3D source rebuilds reproduce the accepted HTML SHA-256 exactly; aquarium uses the preserved dependency tree with unchanged lockfile dependency entries.
